title: Inside the Breakdown of U.K.-Israel Relations Over West Bank Settlements
summary_full: British officials believed Israel had said it would hold off on moving ahead with construction in E1, a piece of land viewed as vital to a future Palestinian state. Israel said it promised no such thing.
